name: Lucy Ferr
source:
An unlucky, yet very cheerful succubus trying really hard to accomplish her... OH LOOK A SQUIRREL!!!

Lucy has a hot-headed, emotional and kind personality. Also she's a scout in the Legions of Darkness. Nothing good may come of this, eh?
